clips.title: The story
paras: The Strange Hermit is an introductory quest in Shadowgale Forest focusing on a shy, hooded recluse living away from civilization. Seeking conversation after long isolation, the hermit shares glimpses of his simple handcrafted life and his bond with the local singing forest spirits.

Deep within the secluded canopy of Shadowgale Forest lives an enigmatic, hooded recluse known simply as the Strange Hermit. Far removed from settled towns and standard trade routes, he spends his days in quiet isolation among the trees. When approached, his awkward speech and nervous demeanor show how long he has lived without ordinary companionship, making even a basic greeting an unfamiliar challenge.

Though solitary, the hermit insists he has all the company and provisions he needs. He confides that he once lived somewhere else before settling here, choosing to make a life surrounded by handmade trinkets and the local forest spirits. While the wild spirits frequently sing to him, he admits that melodic choruses cannot entirely replace speaking with someone who can truly answer back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Uh, um... H-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... It's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.
So er, um... How is your day going?

clips.title: Completion
paras: ...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.
